units.source_text: 幸好千重子没发现这样一所房子，她只顾抬头仰望杉山和并排的杉圆木，就径直走了过去。

en.t: Fortunately, Chieko did not notice such a house; she was only looking up at the cedar-covered mountain and the rows of cedar logs, and walked straight past.

units.source_text: 苗子也就没有谈及这所房子的事。

en.t: Naeko therefore did not mention the house either.
